verdict.rationale: Background automation is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence shows no product feature that lets users set up automations that run autonomously. Webhooks, the Management API for ordering terminals, and the MCP server are developer building blocks or interactive tools. None of them is a configurable, self-running background automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
